description: MeshCore mesh health analyzer for CardputerZero

store.summary: Inspect and configure a MeshCore LoRa mesh from your CardputerZero.
store.description:
A LoRa mesh health analyzer for the CardputerZero. Configure your MeshCore node name, region and radio parameters (frequency, spreading factor, bandwidth, coding rate, TX power, sync word, preamble), verify the LoRa hat at startup, and analyze the health of nearby MeshCore nodes.

Settings mirror MeshCore's lora namespace, so a node configured on the device stays portable to a MeshCore firmware build. Region presets cover Europe, USA/Canada, Australia, New Zealand and the EU 433 band, and any field can be overridden by hand for a custom frequency plan.
